args:
if [ -n "$1" ]; then case "$1" in ""|\$*) ;; *) if [ -x "$1/bin/context-ledger-mcp" ]; then root=$1; shift; exec "$root/bin/context-ledger-mcp" "$@"; fi ;; esac; fi; shift; ver=0.1.17
best=
bestver=
bestmt=0
ver_gt() {
  a=$1
  b=$2
  if [ -z "$a" ]; then return 1; fi
  if [ -z "$b" ]; then return 0; fi
  while true; do
    case $a in
      *.*) aa=$(printf '%s\n' "$a" | cut -d. -f1); a=$(printf '%s\n' "$a" | cut -d. -f2-) ;;
      *) aa=$a; a= ;;
    esac
    case $b in
      *.*) bb=$(printf '%s\n' "$b" | cut -d. -f1); b=$(printf '%s\n' "$b" | cut -d. -f2-) ;;
      *) bb=$b; b= ;;
    esac
    case $aa in *[!0-9]*|"") aa=0 ;; esac
    case $bb in *[!0-9]*|"") bb=0 ;; esac
    if [ "$aa" -gt "$bb" ]; then return 0; fi
    if [ "$aa" -lt "$bb" ]; then return 1; fi
    if [ -z "$a" ] && [ -z "$b" ]; then return 1; fi
  done
}
if [ -n "$HOME" ]; then
  for launcher in "$HOME"/.cursor/plugins/cache/*/context-ledger/*/bin/context-ledger-mcp "$HOME"/.cursor/plugins/cache/*/*/*/bin/context-ledger-mcp
  do
    if [ ! -f "$launcher" ] || [ ! -x "$launcher" ]; then continue; fi
    bindir=$(dirname "$launcher")
    pdir=$(dirname "$bindir")
    pj="$pdir/plugin.json"
    if [ ! -f "$pj" ]; then continue; fi
    name=$(sed -n 's/.*"name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$pj" | head -n 1)
    if [ "$name" != "context-ledger" ]; then continue; fi
    v=$(sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$pj" | head -n 1)
    mt=$(stat -c %Y "$launcher" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -z "$mt" ]; then mt=$(stat -f %m "$launcher" 2>/dev/null); fi
    if [ -z "$mt" ]; then mt=0; fi
    take=0
    if [ -z "$best" ]; then take=1
    elif ver_gt "$v" "$bestver"; then take=1
    elif ver_gt "$bestver" "$v"; then take=0
    elif [ "$mt" -gt "$bestmt" ]; then take=1
    fi
    if [ "$take" = 1 ]; then best=$launcher; bestver=$v; bestmt=$mt; fi
  done
fi
if [ -n "$best" ]; then exec "$best" "$@"; fi
cache_root=$HOME/.cache
if [ -n "$XDG_CACHE_HOME" ]; then cache_root=$XDG_CACHE_HOME; fi
dest="$cache_root/context-ledger/plugin-$ver"
url="https://codeload.github.com/ingpoc/agent-plugins/tar.gz/refs/tags/context-ledger-v$ver"
if [ -x "$dest/bin/context-ledger-mcp" ]; then exec "$dest/bin/context-ledger-mcp" "$@"; fi
workdir=
stage=
fail() {
  printf '%s\n' "{\"ok\":false,\"error\":{\"code\":\"PLUGIN_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED\",\"retryable\":false,\"message\":\"bootstrap failed at $1 for $url\"}}" >&2
  if [ -n "$workdir" ]; then rm -rf "$workdir"; fi
  if [ -n "$stage" ]; then rm -rf "$stage"; fi
  exit 1
}
tmpbase=/tmp
if [ -n "$TMPDIR" ]; then tmpbase=$TMPDIR; fi
workdir=$(mktemp -d "$tmpbase/context-ledger-bootstrap.XXXXXX")
if [ -z "$workdir" ] || [ ! -d "$workdir" ]; then workdir=; fail download; fi
if ! curl -fsSL --max-time 60 -o "$workdir/src.tar.gz" "$url" 2>"$workdir/curl.err"; then fail download; fi
if ! tar -tzf "$workdir/src.tar.gz" > "$workdir/members" 2>"$workdir/tar.err"; then fail extract; fi
if ! grep '/plugins/context-ledger/' "$workdir/members" > "$workdir/wanted"; then fail extract; fi
parent=$(dirname "$dest")
mkdir -p "$parent" || fail move
stage="$parent/.plugin-$ver.$$"
mkdir -p "$stage" || fail move
if ! tar -xzf "$workdir/src.tar.gz" -C "$stage" --strip-components 3 -T "$workdir/wanted" 2>"$workdir/tar.err"; then fail extract; fi
got=$(sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$stage/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
if [ "$got" != "$ver" ]; then fail verify; fi
if [ ! -x "$stage/bin/context-ledger-mcp" ]; then fail verify; fi
if [ -x "$dest/bin/context-ledger-mcp" ]; then rm -rf "$stage" "$workdir"; stage=; workdir=; exec "$dest/bin/context-ledger-mcp" "$@"; fi
if [ -e "$dest" ] && [ ! -x "$dest/bin/context-ledger-mcp" ]; then rm -rf "$dest"; fi
if [ -x "$dest/bin/context-ledger-mcp" ]; then rm -rf "$stage" "$workdir"; stage=; workdir=; exec "$dest/bin/context-ledger-mcp" "$@"; fi
if mv "$stage" "$dest"; then stage=; rm -rf "$workdir"; workdir=; exec "$dest/bin/context-ledger-mcp" "$@"; fi
if [ -x "$dest/bin/context-ledger-mcp" ]; then rm -rf "$stage" "$workdir"; stage=; workdir=; exec "$dest/bin/context-ledger-mcp" "$@"; fi
fail move
